applied.problem: "only fits squares that grow" is false: a pizza half as wide has a quarter of the area, just as half the current gives a quarter of the heat, and the dial goes down to ×0.5.

"a warm wire's resistance changes a little" understates it: a copper conductor at 70 °C has about a fifth more resistance than at 20 °C, and a lamp filament many times more, so "a little" is not true of every real wire.
"changes a little as it warms" understates the change for a hot conductor or a filament; saying it changes as it warms keeps the panel true without a size claim no source gives.
